name: PartyTargetWatch
release_type_reason: Version 0.4.2 removes addon-to-addon focus synchronization and adds minimap/native-settings entry points. The version and both entry points await in-game verification. The earlier 0.4.0 name/icon display and SeUI custom-format workflow were user-confirmed locally; cross-client chat receipt and combat/Mythic+ behavior remain unverified.
icon_rights: Original vector artwork created for PartyTargetWatch, distributed under the MIT License; no third-party game, platform, or addon artwork used.
not_live_verified: Version 0.4.2 loading, two-control settings, status text and saved-setting migration after /reload
Version 0.4.2 minimap left/right clicks, EUI button collection and native Settings AddOns category entry points
Cross-client name declaration receipt, native two-line macro and complete upgrade preservation of saved templates
Multiline declaration editor, cursor scrolling, Chinese input and literal pipe preservation
Draft sample tests, save/cancel boundaries and template persistence
Background-only opacity and transparent background behavior
Target raid markers and scene visibility
compatibility_note: Enable showFocus and acceptFocusCalls for public chat announcements; senders do not need the addon. Yellow names/markers show the latest announcement, expire in five minutes and require another announcement after changing focus; 取消打断 clears the sender record. Secret messages are ignored. The local player public focus can be displayed read-only. No addon focus protocol is registered, sent or handled, and no normal chat is sent.
upgrade_note: The retired shareFocus field is cleared; other switches, templates, position and opacity are preserved. The added Integration.lua brings the release to 8 files and no Bindings.xml; preserve WTF SavedVariables.

checks: Changing scale from 100% to 110% and back to 100%
Updating the player's own selected-target name

declaration_template_limits.leading_chat_raid_marker_token: An initial {rt1} through {rt8} in a captured name is extracted as the declaration marker; conflict with explicit %mark rejects the message.

background_opacity.affects: Background, border and row fills only; text and icons remain visible.

current_user_observations: Historical 0.4.0: on 2026-09-25 the user confirmed native %f expansion, addon receipt and clean icon/name display after the leading-marker fix, and then confirmed the SeUI custom-format workflow. This does not establish arbitrary third-party addon %f support or cross-client/combat/Mythic+ behavior.

ui_entry_points.eui_compatibility_basis: Inspected local GatherMinimapButtons selects named direct Minimap child Buttons, with a nonnumeric name ending and width >= 20. The new button allows collector reparenting and resizing; live behavior awaits reload verification.
